participants.description: The authorised director or owner of the SME business seeking a term loan. Interacts with the Relationship Manager and business portal throughout the journey. Signs the facility agreement. Submits periodic financial information for covenant monitoring in PH-022.

phase_interactions.interaction: Discusses borrowing requirements with RM. Reviews indicative terms. Provides initial financial information.
Formally submits loan application via RM or business portal. Uploads supporting documents.
data_received: application acknowledgement with reference number (EVT-031 notification)
confirmation of next steps and indicative timeline

phase_interactions.interaction: May be contacted by Credit Analyst for clarification on financial statements or business plan. No portal action required.
data_received: no direct notification during assessment phase

phase_interactions.interaction: Receives written notification of approval or decline decision.
data_received: approval letter with approved amount, indicative rate, conditions precedent list, and APRC-equivalent disclosure (EVT-034 notification)
OR decline letter with reasons and BBRS signposting (EVT-035 notification)

phase_interactions.interaction: Reviews, negotiates if required, and executes the facility agreement. Arranges satisfaction of conditions precedent.
Submits drawdown instruction specifying amount and destination account. Receives drawdown confirmation.
data_received: drawdown confirmation letter with first repayment date, repayment schedule, and outstanding balance (EVT-037 notification)

phase_interactions.interaction: Submits periodic financial information for covenant testing. Receives covenant test results. Engages with RM on breach remediation if required.
data_received: covenant compliance confirmation or breach notification

participants.description: The bank's dedicated commercial relationship manager for the SME customer. Originates the deal in PH-016, supports the formal application in PH-017, presents the credit paper in PH-019, coordinates the facility agreement in PH-020, and conducts annual reviews in PH-022. The RM is the primary point of contact for PER-002 throughout the journey.

phase_interactions.interaction: Conducts initial needs analysis. Records preliminary deal in CRM pipeline. Issues indicative terms.
system_actions: Creates deal record in SVC-005 pipeline module
Reviews ENT-B001 customer profile and existing facilities

phase_interactions.interaction: Validates application completeness. Submits formal application in SVC-005 (or assists customer via portal).
system_actions: Uploads supporting documents to SVC-005 document store

phase_interactions.interaction: For within-RM-authority amounts: approves or declines directly. For above-authority amounts: presents credit paper to committee and records outcome.
system_actions: Records committee decision on CreditAssessment.committee_decision in SVC-005

phase_interactions.interaction: Coordinates with legal team for facility agreement preparation. Tracks conditions precedent. Notifies customer on CP satisfaction.
Conducts annual review with Credit Analyst. Manages covenant breach escalation. Coordinates waiver process if required.
system_actions: Initiates re-assessment request to Credit Analyst on breach

participants.description: The bank's credit analyst responsible for preparing the credit paper in PH-018. Reviews the automated IRB scores from SVC-012, conducts qualitative assessment (sector, management quality, financial ratios, security coverage), and prepares the credit paper for committee review. SMCR Certified Function holder for credit analysis.

phase_interactions.interaction: Reviews automated CreditAssessment (EVT-033 data). Prepares full credit paper. May request additional information from customer via RM. Submits credit paper to committee.
system_actions: Reads ENT-018 (CreditAssessment) from SVC-012 via EVT-033
Records analyst narrative and supplementary fields on ENT-018 via SVC-012 API

phase_interactions.interaction: Presents credit paper to credit committee. Answers committee questions. Records committee decision.
Reviews covenant test results. Prepares watch-list paper if breach detected. Supports annual review.
system_actions: Prepares updated credit paper for annual review

participants.description: The primary system service for the journey. Orchestrates the loan origination workflow, owns ENT-017/ENT-019/ENT-020/ENT-021, publishes 8 events, and coordinates with SVC-012 (async) and SVC-009 (sync) for cross-capability interactions.

phase_interactions.interaction: Read access to ENT-B001 for customer profile.
Creates ENT-017 (LoanApplication). Publishes EVT-031, EVT-032.
Consumes EVT-033. Routes to Credit Analyst.
Records committee decision. Publishes EVT-034 or EVT-035.
Creates ENT-019 (FacilityAgreement). Publishes EVT-036.
Creates ENT-020 (LoanAccount). Instructs SVC-009. Publishes EVT-037, EVT-038.
Creates ENT-021 (CovenantMonitoring). Publishes EVT-039 on breach.

participants.description: Cross-capability risk scoring service. Owned by CAP-004. Consumes EVT-032, creates ENT-018, publishes EVT-033. Also subscribes to EVT-037/EVT-038/EVT-039 for ongoing portfolio capital and IFRS 9 management.

phase_interactions.interaction: Consumes EVT-032. Creates ENT-018. Publishes EVT-033.
Consumes EVT-037, EVT-038 for RWA and IFRS 9 updates.
Consumes EVT-039 for IFRS 9 SICR re-assessment.

participants.description: Payment execution service (CAP-003). Receives synchronous drawdown payment instruction from SVC-005 in PH-021. Executes CHAPS or BACS credit to BusinessAccount. Returns settlement confirmation to SVC-005.

phase_interactions.interaction: Executes drawdown disbursement to BusinessAccount via CHAPS. Returns settlement confirmation.
